unit.why: A single anecdote: the Besht sees the pillar of Torah-light of the late R. Shimshon of Annopol through a window, and R. Yosef of Kamenka keeps closing it.

stories.end_quote: מה שאמר ר' גרשון גוסכם גיסכם
stories.summary_en: The Besht avoided Annopol because R. Shimshon had already repaired everything there. Later, invited there, he kept opening a window during a meal. When R. Yosef of Kamenka kept closing it, the Besht rebuked him and explained that he was gazing at R. Shimshon's pillar of Torah rising from earth to heaven over the spot where R. Shimshon's study hall had stood. He then understood what his brother-in-law R. Gershon had claimed to perceive there.
